answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 70 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in delta, queued in atlas, and fable publishes the wait time. A farm of 181 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2839 identities would post 1798 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
